3.  $\nu_3: ^4T_{1g}(F) \to ^4T_{1g}(P) = 20,250\text{ cm}^{-1}$

The resulting parameters are:
*   **$Dq \approx 979\text{ cm}^{-1}$**
*   **$B \approx 853\text{ cm}^{-1}$**

These values provide an excellent fit to the observed spectrum, with a root-mean-square error (RMSE) of approximately $0.02\text{ cm}^{-1}$.
